comparison.objective: Remove a fragile egg obstruction before placing a pot on a trivet; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires hazard inspection, gentle egg relocation, and stable pot placement rather than threaded adjustment with two tools.
comparison.success_condition: Checks egg clearance and safe support, pot support, release, stillness, and strict contact-damage limits; candidate checks angle accuracy, nuts, functional cycles, drift, and clearance.
comparison.reason: The record tests safe obstruction clearing and placement, with no calibrated mechanism or lock-retention ability.
